name: Environmentally Preferable Purchasing  FY15 - Goods
description:
This dataset lists goods purchased through a city government's Environmentally Preferable Purchasing (EPP) program during fiscal year 2015. Each of the 13 records covers one contract and includes the product description (such as shredding machines, calendars, business cards, or ballasts), whether an EPP minimum standard was indicated (either Energy Star compliance or a 30% minimum recycled content requirement), the contract start and end dates, the registration date, and the contract value in dollars.

The data can be used to review how municipal purchasing aligns with environmental standards, compare contract values across product categories, and examine contract timing and duration. It supports reporting on sustainable procurement practices and could help identify which product types most often carry green purchasing requirements.
